lessons.trigger_condition: V400 card-measurement confidence read V109_FINAL_VERIFICATION_REPORT.json even though verify_current_runtime.py defines CURRENT_RUNTIME_VERIFICATION_REPORT.json as the current-main verification evidence and treats historical V109 reports as audit-only.
lessons.prevention_rule: Prefer CURRENT_RUNTIME_VERIFICATION_REPORT.json only when the aggregate result is successful and the successful pass contains active_tablet_runtime, card_core_static_regressions, and current_runtime_regressions. Never promote an incomplete current report. Use V109 only as a conservative policy-checked historical fallback, and treat missing or invalid evidence as a revalidation deficit.
validation_required: the only watched runtime path changed by the candidate is tablet_autonomous_evolution_v400.py
fresh successful CURRENT_RUNTIME_VERIFICATION_REPORT.json with all required card/runtime regressions is preferred
an incomplete current runtime report is not promoted even when its aggregate ok flag is true
V109 remains historical policy-checked fallback only
missing current and historical verification remains fail-closed with zero measurement verification confidence
price, grade, release, event and market-direction invention remain forbidden
physical tablet runtime and Drive readback remain unverified until matching external evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V395 changes only evidence selection for the V400 card-measurement surface. It does not widen grading trust, import model weights or raw peer state, auto-generate or rewrite source code, execute arbitrary commands, write Git/main at runtime, bypass V399/V398 or earlier hard gates, or claim physical-device success without evidence.
